16-11-31
D.b. Crime
Sir,
I beg to report that I saw the doctor named
Tsew Wei Li (周惠禮) of Kai Mai Hospital 273/4
Tientsin Road (not 244 Kwangae Road as per statement)
who said that about 12 m.n. 2-11-31 he received
the woman and found her having taken some opium.
Without accommodation nor nurse in his
hospital, he after treatment advised them (e.g. 216
and his friend Tang Ah Foo) to put her in Mei Lu
Hospital, on Avenue Road.
He also noticed that on her leaving at about
1 am 3-11-31 she was not in very critical con-
dition as she was able to walk along with others.

To 2nd doctor named Yong See Jung (楊其誠)
of Mei Lu Hospital 130A Avenue Road, who said that
on her arrival at about 2 a.m. 3-11-31 she was in
a serious condition and unable to talk, that he
tried to save her by using every means at his
command. but at about 5 a.m. same morning
she died of opium poison, and that after the
visit of a foreign detective and that of a Chinese
detective the body was removed at about 6 a.m.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
Leu Lien
D.I.

1931年11月16日
D.b. 刑事科
先生，
谨报告，我见到了凯迈医院（Kai Mai Hospital）的医生 Tsew Wei Li（周惠禮），地址为天津路273/4号（并非如陈述中所称的光爱路244号），他说在1931年11月2日午夜12点左右，他接收了该女子，发现她服用了一些鸦片。
由于他的医院没有病房也没有护士，他在治疗后建议他们（即 216号 和他的朋友 Tang Ah Foo）将她送往爱文义路的美陆医院（Mei Lu Hospital）。
他还注意到，在1931年11月3日凌晨1点左右离开时，她的情况并不十分危急，因为她能够与他人一同行走。

致美陆医院（Mei Lu Hospital）的第二位医生 Yong See Jung（楊其誠），地址为爱文义路130A号，他说在1931年11月3日凌晨2点左右她到达时，情况严重且无法说话，他尝试使用一切手段进行抢救，但在当天早上5点左右，她因鸦片中毒死亡，并且在外籍侦探和华籍侦探探视后，尸体于早上6点左右被移走。

先生，
您顺从的仆人，
Leu Lien
督察

page_data.en:
Nov. 14, 1913
（批：Rec 14/11）

Sir,
I beg to submit the following report about a female Chinese who committed suicide as per your instructions d. 10-11-31.
The deceased "Chang Tsai Nyoh" was a native of Fenghua, Ningpo.
C.O.C. 216 became acquainted with the deceased at No 10 Rue Voin French Town while on watch duty here in connection with a robbery case the 2nd day after the apprehension of the two robbers. i.e., 13-5-31.
The deceased did not live there at the time although she had lived in the Alley before. Apparently they made the acquaintance while C.O.C. 216 on watch duty and the deceased visiting her old neighbour Ong Ming Lung (翁明祿) the keeper of the opium den at the address. Ong is a shroff by profession.
Previous to her connection with the C.O.C. she had a sweetheart, a carpenter by profession but in reality a loafer. The pair got estranged because the woman was fond of gambling.
She went to Hankow last winter and there she lived with a man in the Local Government Service and separated later as the man found her too much for him. She returned Shanghai sometimes during the May this year.
Lost her money at Sung Kyui Li Gambling house. LANE NO 5 Hu. say. off Boulevard de Montigny French Town. Ong said that he gave her from $60. to $70. a month for daily expenses.

I am, Sir
your obedient servant.
Sz Seu-lin
D.I.
page_data.zh:
1913年11月14日
（批注：收到 14/11）

先生，
谨遵照您1931年11月10日的指示，提交关于一名自杀的中国女性的以下报告。
死者“Chang Tsai Nyoh”是宁波奉化人。
华籍侦探警员 216号 在法租界 Voisin 路10号执勤时结识了死者，当时正值两名劫匪被捕后的第二天，即1931年5月13日，他在此处理一起抢劫案。
死者当时并未住在那里，尽管她以前曾住在该弄堂里。显然，他们是在 216号 执勤期间，死者拜访其老邻居 Ong Ming Lung（翁明祿）时相识的，Ong 是该地址鸦片烟馆的老板。Ong 的职业是银钱业职员（shroff）。
在与该华籍侦探警员交往之前，她有一个情人，职业是木匠，但实际上是个游手好闲之徒。两人因该女子嗜赌而疏远。
去年冬天她去了汉口，在那里与一名地方政府服务人员同居，后来因该男子觉得她负担太重而分手。今年五月间某时她回到上海。
在宋桂里赌场输掉了钱。地址：法租界蒙梯尼大道（Boulevard de Montigny）附近的胡家巷5号。Ong 说他每月给她60至70美元作为日常开销。

先生，
您顺从的仆人。
Sz Seu-lin
督察

page_data.en:
Inquest No. 5375.(Louza) held at the Public Mortuary before Procurator Lee
Ying, on the body of a female Chinese named Chiang Tsai Nyoh, age 30, who
met her death at 5.a.m on the 3.11.31, in the Wei Lee Hospital on Avenue
Road.

Proceedings.

S.I.Bebenin :- At now deceased lived at No.756 Peking Road, and shortly
after 4.p.m yesterday, a friend of the deceased went to her room, and found
her lying on the bed very ill, so he at once took her to the Koh Ming Hospi-
tal No.244 Kwangse Road. After receiving treatment, the doctor said she
was fit to go, and on her way home, she became ill again, so she was removed
to the Wei Lee Hospital, where she died at 5.a.m the 3.11.31. According to
the doctor's certificate the deceased died from opium poisoning. A search
was made in her house but nothing could be found, to show why she took the
opium. She has no relatives in Shanghai but has a friend Chinese detective
No.260.

C.D.C.230 :- C.D.C.260 came to the station and reported that the now
deceased died at No.756 Peking Road, so I went to the premises and made a
search, but found no opium, and I also asked the people in the house but
they knew nothing.

C.D.C.260.:- I do not know when the deceased took the opium. I know she
wanted some money to go back home, and after she received the money she
gambled it away, and became depressed over it.

Witness Chang Ah Foo :- The detective is a friend of the deceased and he
often came to visit her. On the 1st of this month, I returned home at 11.p.
m, and found the deceased lying on my bed, and she did not wake up until
10.a.m the following morning (2nd inst), and then she left the house at 10.p
m the same day. Later I was passing by her house No.756 Peking Road and saw
a light upstairs, so I went up and found the deceased lying on her bed, and
when I asked her what was the matter, she could not speak, so I took her to
the hospital.

Verdict :- I find that the deceased committed suicide by taking poison.
Body to be removed for burial by her friend C.D.C.260 Wong
Kwei Sung.

F.Boorman.
3.11.31.
page_data.zh:
第5375号死因研讯。（老闸）在公共停尸房由检察官李英主持，针对一名名为 Chiang Tsai Nyoh 的30岁中国女性尸体进行研讯，她于1931年11月3日凌晨5点在爱文义路的魏立医院（Wei Lee Hospital）死亡。

程序记录。

高级督察 Bebenin :- 死者生前居住在北京路756号，昨天下午4点后不久，死者的一位朋友去她的房间，发现她病重躺在床上，于是他立即将她送往光西路244号的柯明医院（Koh Ming Hospital）。接受治疗后，医生说她可以离开，但在回家途中，她再次发病，于是被送往魏立医院，并于1931年11月3日凌晨5点在那里死亡。根据医生的证明，死者死于鸦片中毒。对其住所进行了搜查，但未发现任何能表明她为何服用鸦片的物品。她在上海没有亲属，但有一位朋友，即华籍侦探警员 260号。

华籍侦探警员 230号 :- 华籍侦探警员 260号 来到警局报告说，死者在北京路756号死亡，所以我前往该处所进行了搜查，但没有发现鸦片，我也询问了屋内的人，但他们一无所知。

华籍侦探警员 260号 :- 我不知道死者何时服用的鸦片。我知道她想要一些钱回老家，拿到钱后她赌博输光了，并因此感到沮丧。

证人 Chang Ah Foo :- 该侦探是死者的朋友，他经常来看望她。本月1日晚上11点，我回到家，发现死者躺在我的床上，她直到第二天（2日）上午10点才醒来，然后在当天下午10点离开了房子。后来我路过她位于北京路756号的家，看到楼上有灯光，于是我上楼发现死者躺在床上，当我问她怎么了时，她说不出话，所以我把她送到了医院。

裁决 :- 我认定死者服毒自杀。
尸体由其朋友华籍侦探警员 260号 Wong Kwei Sung 移走安葬。

F.Boorman.
1931年11月3日。

Form No.2
G. 21,500-1-31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.__________
Louza Station,
REPORT
Date 3rd November 1931

Subject (in full) Suicide of female Chinese.

Made by D.P.S.Gibson. Forwarded by A.O'Dwyer. C.I.

Sir,
At 4.45 a.m.3-11-31,Wong Kwei Sung (王桂生) (C.D.C.216)
reported to the station that a female Chinese,Chiang Tsai Mu
(蔣雪娥) had committed suicide by opium poisoning at 756 Peking
Road.
Enquiries by the undersigned and C.D.C.230 found that the
woman was Chiang Tsai Mu (蔣雪娥),30,native of Ningpo,residing
at 756 Peking Road. At 10 p.m.2-11-31,one Tsang Ah Foo (張阿富)
went to 756 Peking Road where he found the deceased woman lying
sick. She was removed to the Ren He Hospital,244 Kwangse Road,
where the doctor stated the woman was fit to be removed to her
home. On the way she again became ill and was taken to the
Lelu Hospital,180 Avenue Road at 1.45 a.m. where she was certified
dead at 4 a.m. C.D.C.216 stated he had known the woman for
over seven months during which time he had been the woman's
sweetheart. On the 31-10-31, the deceased stated she wished to go
to Ningpo and was given $30.00 by C.D.C.216 to do so. She did
not go to Ningpo but went to Frenchtown where she was seen by
Tsang Ah Foo (張阿富) who told C.D.C.216. At 10 p.m.2-11-31,
C.D.C.216 sent this man to call the woman who was then discovered
sick. C.D.C.216 states he knows of no reason why the
suicide should have been committed. A search of the room at 756
Peking Road failed to disclose any letters or other evidence by
which the motive could be ascertained. The body has been
removed to the Public Mortuary pending inquest.
Doctor's cert states 'Died from opium poisoning'.

（批：5017 Examination）
（签名）
A Gibson
D.P.S.I.
C.D.C.230.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号__________
老闸巡捕房，
报告
日期 1931年11月3日

主题（完整）一名中国女性自杀。

由 D.P.S. Gibson 制作。由 C.I. A. O'Dwyer 转发。

先生，
1931年11月3日凌晨4点45分，Wong Kwei Sung（王桂生）（华籍侦探警员 216号）向警局报告，一名名为 Chiang Tsai Mu（蔣雪娥）的中国女性在北京路756号因鸦片中毒自杀。
经本人及华籍侦探警员 230号 查询，查明该女子为 Chiang Tsai Mu（蔣雪娥），30岁，宁波人，居住于北京路756号。1931年11月2日晚上10点，一名 Tsang Ah Foo（張阿富）前往北京路756号，发现死者患病卧床。她被送往光西路244号的仁和医院，医生表示该女子适合搬回家中。在途中她再次发病，并于凌晨1点45分被送往爱文义路180号的乐陆医院（Lelu Hospital），于凌晨4点被宣告死亡。华籍侦探警员 216号 称他认识该女子已超过七个月，在此期间他是该女子的情人。1931年10月31日，死者表示想去宁波，华籍侦探警员 216号 给了她30.00美元作为路费。她没有去宁波，而是去了法租界，被 Tsang Ah Foo（張阿富）看见，后者告知了华籍侦探警员 216号。1931年11月2日晚上10点，华籍侦探警员 216号 派此人去叫该女子，随后发现她生病了。华籍侦探警员 216号 称他不知道自杀的原因。对北京路756号房间的检查未能发现任何信件或其他可查明动机的证据。尸体已移至公共停尸房，等待死因研讯。
医生证明写明“死于鸦片中毒”。

（批注：5017 审查）
（签名）
A Gibson
副督察长 I 级
华籍侦探警员 230号。

Form 40
G. 10,000-1-31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of C.D.C.216 of Louza Police Station
native of ____________________ taken by me _________________
at Louza Station on the 7-11-31 translated
and interpreted by Clerk Hien Sr. Tao.

On 17-5-31 I acquainted the deceased woman at No.10 Rue
Voisin, Frenchtown. Later on at about 4.p.m. 19-5-31 I met her
again on Foochow Road where she told me the whole story about her
life during the last few years from which I learned that her husband
was died of sickness for several years ago and now she felt very
sorry for her future livelihood as she has no fix abode yet since
she came to Shanghai. So she requested me to accept her. Then I
told her that I have married and could not marry any body again,
but she said that it was not the matter for either to be wife or
concubine as the only thing she requested is bread.

On June 16th, we rented a room at 756 Peking Road. I
paid $20.00 for her daily expenses on every fifth day as usual.

At 11.00.p.m. on 31-10-31 she said to me that she wished
to go to Ningpo in collecting some of her debts and visiting her old
friends too, and asked me in advanced of this month's daily expenses
for her travelling money which I given $30.00 to do so. And
told me that she would come back after one week. On the next day
she gave me all keys and left the home.

At 5.p.m. 1-11-31 I went to 218 Amoy Road to meet my
friend named Tsang Ah Fu (張阿富) from office who told me that
she went to his home at 12.midnight on 1-11-31 and told Tsang
Ah Fu that she was delay to board the ship on that day and the
travelling money was all lost by gambling in Frenchtown. She left
his home until at 11.a.m. 2-11-31. On her leaving she told Tsang
that she went to Frenchtown for some thing.

At 7.00.p.m. I left there as I was on duty on patrol. At
10.00p.m. when I was off duty I went to Amoy Road again and was told

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
警方调查报告。

以下是老闸巡捕房华籍侦探警员 216号 的陈述，籍贯 ____________________，由我 _________________ 于1931年11月7日在老闸巡捕房录取，由高级文员 Tao 先生翻译和口译。

1931年5月17日，我在法租界 Voisin 路10号结识了死者。后来在1931年5月19日下午4点左右，我在福州路再次见到她，她向我讲述了过去几年里的全部生活经历，从中我得知她的丈夫几年前因病去世，现在她对自己的未来生计感到非常担忧，因为自从她来到上海后还没有固定的住所。所以她请求我接纳她。然后我告诉她我已经结婚，不能再娶任何人，但她说无论是做妻子还是妾室都无所谓，她唯一要求的是有饭吃。

6月16日，我们在北京路756号租了一个房间。我像往常一样每五天支付她20.00美元作为日常开销。

1931年10月31日晚上11点，她对我说她想去宁波收债并拜访老朋友，并预支本月的日常开销作为旅费，我给了她30.00美元。并告诉我她一周后会回来。第二天她把所有的钥匙都给了我，然后离开了家。

1931年11月1日下午5点，我去厦门路218号见我的朋友 Tsang Ah Fu（張阿富），他下班后告诉我，她在1931年11月1日午夜12点去了他家，并告诉 Tsang Ah Fu 她那天耽误了上船，旅费在法租界赌博全输光了。她一直待在他家直到1931年11月2日上午11点。离开时她告诉 Tsang 她去法租界办点事。

晚上7点我离开那里，因为我要去巡逻执勤。晚上10点下班后，我又去了厦门路，被告知

by Tsang Ah Fu that she has gone there and shortly left. When
I talked with Tsang's father, Tsang Ah Fu left the home. At 11.p.m.
he came back and told me that she went back her home and the
door was open by some way and she looks suffering from some poi-
soning. As soon as I heard these words I immediately went her
home and she said to me that she was very sorry for me. Then I
together with Tsang Ah Fu and Wong Ah U (王阿有) brought her to
Keh Mei Hospital (克美醫院) 244 Kiangsu Road where the doctor
stated the woman was fit to be removed to her home. On the way
she again became ill and was taken to the Wei Lu Hospital (惠旅醫院)
130A Avenue Road where she was certified dead at 4.a.m. I report-
ed to the Station after an inquiry was made by detectives the
body was removed to the Public Mortuary.
This is my true statement.

Signed : Wong Kwai Sung (王桂生)

以下是____________________________________________________的陈述
籍贯______________________________由我__________________________________于________________________在________________________录取，并由______________口译

Tsang Ah Fu 说她去过那里并很快离开了。
当我和 Tsang 的父亲谈话时，Tsang Ah Fu 离开了家。晚上11点
他回来告诉我，她回到了自己家，门不知怎么开着，她看起来像是遭受了某种中
毒。我一听到这些话就立刻去了她家，她对我说她对我感到很抱歉。然后我
和 Tsang Ah Fu 以及 Wong Ah U（王阿有）一起把她带到了江苏路244号的克美医院（Keh Mei Hospital），医生
表示该女子适合搬回家中。在途中
她再次发病，并被送往爱文义路130A号的惠旅医院（Wei Lu Hospital），于凌晨4点被宣告死亡。在侦探进行调查后，我向警局报告，
尸体被移至公共停尸房。
这是我的真实陈述。

签名 : Wong Kwai Sung（王桂生）
